step1_analysis.circuit_type: Switched-capacitor switch with local clock buffer
step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a switch driven by a local two-stage clock buffer (XM1-XM4). Due to both switch transistors (XM5, XM6) being NMOS in the extracted netlist, it acts as an always-on switch that alternates conduction between the two transistors depending on the clock phase. This was likely intended as a complementary transmission gate where the PMOS was misidentified during extraction.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 140-W 88-dB Audio Sigma-Delta Modulator in 90-nm CMOS

Ron_high.description: ON resistance of the switch when CLK is high

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters in the linear region with a 0.9V DC input.

Ron_low.description: ON resistance of the switch when CLK is low

sky130_expected.calculation: Same as Ron_high, as XM6 is driven by the inverted clock (N6) and has the same dimensions.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetry in the extracted netlist causes the switch to remain ON during the low clock phase via XM6.

Bandwidth.description: -3dB bandwidth of the switch in the ON state with a 1pF load

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the calculated Ron and a standard 1pF test load.

Power.description: Dynamic power consumption of the clock buffer at 50 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C_total * VDD^2 * f. C_total ~ 100fF. P = 100e-15 * 1.8^2 * 50e6 = 16.2 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 140 uW (typoed as 140 W in metadata) for the entire ADC at 1V. The clock buffer alone in 1.8V SKY130 will consume a fraction of this.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure ON resistance in both clock phases, AC bandwidth, and dynamic power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN4 N4 0 1.8
VN5 N5 0 0

VCLK CLK 0 DC 1.8 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
I_test OUT 0 10u
CLOAD OUT 0 1p

XM1 N6 CLK N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N6 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N6 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 CLK N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 IN N3 OUT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT N6 IN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

.control
  * AC Analysis for Bandwidth
  ac dec 10 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
  meas ac bw_high when gain_db=-3 fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis for Ron and Power
  tran 0.1n 40n
  
  * Measure Ron when CLK is high (t=5n)
  meas tran v_in_high find v(IN) at=5n
  meas tran v_out_high find v(OUT) at=5n
  let ron_high = (v_in_high - v_out_high) / 10u
  print ron_high
  
  * Measure Ron when CLK is low (t=15n)
  meas tran v_in_low find v(IN) at=15n
  meas tran v_out_low find v(OUT) at=15n
  let ron_low = (v_in_low - v_out_low) / 10u
  print ron_low
  
  * Measure dynamic power of the clock buffer
  meas tran i_vdd_integ integ i(VN4) from=0 to=40n
  let avg_power = - (i_vdd_integ / 40n) * 1.8
  print avg_power
  
  quit
.endc
.end
